description: Human access reviews for routes whose derived access is UNKNOWN (lib/routes/routeRegistry.ts). Each review records the intended audience, the controls traced in source, open findings and test evidence, and is bound to the sha256 of every file reviewed: any change to those files makes the review stale and the route returns to UNKNOWN (CI fails until re-reviewed). A review is a classification (L1), never certification.

reviews.audience: Anonymous site visitors and portal clients using the site-wide Milano Execution Copilot (app/layout.tsx).
controls: Same-origin only (Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site); cross-site 403 before any provider call
Body 8 KB, message 2,000 chars, projected context 2,000 chars; 413 before any provider call
ASSISTANT_ENABLED=false off-switch and missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY both 503 before any provider call
Output bounded to 512 tokens on claude-haiku-4-5
No server data: client context reduced to a per-role allow-list; unknown roles fall back to PUBLIC

Durable limits: 20 per client per 10 min, 2,000 per day globally — Durable server-side limit before any provider call: public.consume_public_request_limit (atomic per-window upsert, Postgres row lock); per client (HMAC of user id or address) then global daily; 429 + Retry-After; limiter or storage failure 503 (fail closed)
Provider SDK automatic retries disabled (maxRetries 0): one counted request is at most one paid call
Malformed, oversized or cross-site requests are refused before any allowance is consumed
openFindings: Hosted migration 20261125120000_public_request_limits.sql not yet applied: until it is, the limiter fails closed (503) and the Copilot is unavailable — apply before deploying this change
Provider-side workspace spend limit not verifiable from the repository (Anthropic Console, owner action)
reviews.reviewedBy: Engineering access review (Claude Code) — classification only, not certification
